newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kong Tai interim net loss HK$91.15 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kong Tai interim net loss HK$91.15 mln.

text.p: Company name Kong Tai International Holdings Co Ltd
NOTE - Kong Tai is a property concern.
The company changed its financial year-end to December 31 from March 31. Comparative figures are for six-months ended September 30, 1995.

The exceptional items represent a gain on disposal of industrial leasehold land and buildings situated in Hong Kong of HK$12.6 million, a gain on disposal of subsidiaries of HK$31.6 million, a loss on disposal of listed investments of HK$24.6 million, revaluation deficits written off of HK$10.3 million and full provision for a short-term loan receivable extended to Bigland Development Ltd, a private company incorporated in Hong Kong, of HK$76 million. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6368
